constraints: RESEARCH_SA only: this DRAFT has no implementation authority or readiness judgment. Existing READY/DONE task bodies and contracts remain unchanged.

invariants: The exact task, candidate and evaluator identities bind every acceptance or resume claim; missing evidence never grants acceptance.

architectureDecisions: Bind canonical normalized original task, verifications and declared context identity separately from materialized prompt; bind authority-bearing model/permission/tool launch fields and declared limits before spawning. Never hash or store credential values.
Reject drift before reopening side effects; no same-id fallback. Treat supported credential rotation as an explicit out-of-band operational policy, not permission or model drift.
Do not retrofit terminal BB-101 artifacts. Define a fail-closed compatibility boundary for existing handle files and test unchanged recovery with the delivered crash fixture.
implementationSlices: S1 — Pin contract/API and execute the discriminating prototype in the research brief; proposed future implementation files are not claimed to exist.
S2 — After fresh READY, implement only the declared seam and focused positive/negative fixtures.
S3 — Run focused regressions, bind independent evidence and reconcile Living descriptions before Worker judgment.
